snippet.title: POKÉMON NOVA FULL RELEASE TRAILER
snippet.description:
An open-world widescreen fangame set in the Ultra Megalopolis from Pokémon Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon! Explore the Ultra Space in an adventure focused on story, puzzles, and exploration!

This is a non-profit fangame. It will be free upon release.

OFFICIAL DOWNLOAD: https://phiongames.blogspot.com/2026/06/v1.html

More news coming soon at: @pkmn_realidea
